title: 第21章 圣女的投资 这可比找鼎炉有趣多了第22章 娘子别哭为夫还能再战
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
lines: 原本，苏夭夭，只是对李长生有点兴趣。
也就是将之当成可利用的棋子。
李长生半跪在地上，拄着断了半截的玄霜剑，大口大口地喘着粗气。
青铜面具早已碎裂，露出白发苍苍的老脸。
燃烧生命，爆发神通，强杀谢剑，让他的身体早已不堪重负。
他在能量风暴中，同样受伤不轻。
五脏六腑都像移位了一样。
全身骨头和肌肉都发出火辣辣的疼痛。
李长生嘴角一甜，突然吐出一口夹带着内脏的鲜血。
李长生很累，很困，想坐下休息一下。
但他知道现在还不是时候。
青云宗高层已在路上了。
content_en:
Originally, Su Yaoyao was only slightly interested in Li Changsheng.
Um?
In other words, treat it as an exploitable chess piece.
Now it's a little different.
Got some other ideas.
……
for a long time.
The smoke has settled.
Li Changsheng was half-kneeling on the ground, holding the half-broken Xuanshuang Sword, breathing heavily.
The bronze mask had long been shattered, revealing an old face with gray hair.
This time he really got older.
Not in disguise.
Burning life, exploding magical powers, and forcibly killing Xie Jian, his body was already overwhelmed.
and.
He was also seriously injured in the energy storm.
Clothes torn.
Covered in blood.
There is a dent in the chest.
Several ribs were broken.
All the internal organs seemed to be displaced.
All the bones and muscles in his body were burning with pain.
Ahem...
Li Changsheng's mouth turned sweet, and he suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood with internal organs.
Reach out.
Wiped the corners of his mouth.
Show a faint smile.
"Finally survived."
"And the whole family is neat and tidy."
"It feels so good."
…
Li Changsheng was very tired and sleepy, and wanted to sit down and take a rest.
But he knew now wasn't the time.
We still have to deal with the scene!
There's too much movement here.
The senior officials of Qingyun Sect are already on their way.
As a cultivator.
His disguise was spot on.
Hide your trump card.
Hidden magical powers.
Don't cause trouble, don't be in the limelight.
It is always his code of conduct.
